documents.title: Cardiology Annual Follow-up (01/17/2023)
documents.author: cardiology
documents.body:
Cardiology, amyloid clinic follow-up, 01/17/2023

One year on tafamidis, taking it daily without side effects. Breathless only on hills; edema controlled on furosemide 20 mg. No chest pain, no syncope, no palpitations.
Exam: BP and heart rate normal, regular rhythm. JVP normal. No edema. Lungs clear.
Impression: wild-type ATTR cardiac amyloidosis, stable symptoms.
Plan: continue tafamidis 61 mg daily and furosemide 20 mg daily. Primary care to continue kidney and potassium checks. Return in one year.

Cardiology

documents.title: Tafamidis PA renewal
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Specialty pharmacy called: tafamidis prior authorization up for annual renewal, cardiology submitting. They asked us to confirm he's still on furosemide and atorvastatin for their profile; confirmed. Patient has 3 weeks of capsules on hand.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Follow-up Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Neurology added entacapone in December; he thinks mornings are maybe a little easier, hard to say. Wife agrees it's not dramatic.
Neurology asked us to keep an eye on mood. PHQ-9 6 today: low energy and less interest in his puzzles, sleep fine, no thoughts of self-harm. He says he's 'just quieter.' Offered a referral to a counselor who sees people with Parkinson's; he'd rather not right now, and his wife will let us know if that changes.
Cardiac: stable, cardiology letter from January reviewed.
Exam: hypomimia, soft voice, rest tremor R. Heart regular. Lungs clear. No edema.
A/P
1. PD: on entacapone per neurology.
2. Mood disorder related to PD: mild; counseling offered, declined for now; rescreen at each visit.
3. ATTR-wt cardiac amyloidosis: BMP today.
4. Achalasia, CAD: stable.
AWV in the fall.

documents.title: Lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Ron, kidney function and potassium from yesterday are stable and fine on the furosemide. No changes.

medications.reason: Stopped by neurology 6/2023, no added benefit

documents.title: Medicare Annual Wellness Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
AWV, with wife.
Med reconciliation: he brought bottles, no entacapone among them. Says neurology stopped it in June because it wasn't adding anything; we never got that note. Removed from list. Current: carbidopa/levodopa 25/100 TID, pramipexole ER 1.5 mg, tafamidis 61 mg, furosemide 20 mg, atorvastatin 20 mg, aspirin 81 mg.
Function: independent in self-care, slower. No falls. TUG 13 s. Mini-Cog 5/5.
Mood: PHQ-9 5, still declines counseling.
Exam: rest tremor R, hypomimia. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. No edema.
Vaccines: high-dose flu, updated COVID, and RSV vaccine today (heart disease, age).
Labs today. Return in 6 months.

documents.title: Appointment
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Can we move my March appointment to the afternoon? Mornings are when I am slowest. Thank you, Ron

documents.body: Hi Ron, done: you're now 3/19 at 2:30 pm.
